usageContract.materializationRule: Clone grid_table_col_multiselect_wrapper and all descendants, then merge the complete pageLevelDependencies into the generated Dashboard page. Do not recreate this as a legacy Flex Grid table, a static card list, or a Collection without page actions.
usageContract.hostRule: Place only inside an approved Dashboard page business-content slot.
editableRegions: native tablecols labels, sortable fields, and repeated item controls
usageContract.lockedRule: Preserve native responsive settings, Table/Card trees, selection controls, Collection actions, and all page-level dependencies; only supported source/list/field/name remapping is allowed.
usageContract.multiselectBehavior: Preserve selected item IDs/count, batch completion, batch deletion, confirmation flows, reset actions, and row/card selection toggle behavior.
usageContract.displayOnlyMode: For Form Report or Data Report sources, omit write controls, batch mutation actions, and item operation menus; do not claim multiselect write behavior.
usageContract.proofBoundary: Export-proven and configuration-visible responsive/multiselect behavior only. Verify an installed generated page at desktop/tablet/mobile and exercise batch actions before claiming runtime proof.
